title: Housekeeping
description: Comprehensive floor-to-ceiling cleaning schedules customized to your facility’s needs and traffic patterns, backed by hospital-grade disinfection protocols that keep workspaces healthy and germ-free.
shortDescription: Daily cleaning, deep sanitization, and hygiene management for spotless spaces.

title: Guest House Management
description: End-to-end guest house and accommodation management ensuring comfort, cleanliness, and hospitality for corporate guests.
shortDescription: Complete guest house operations and hospitality management.

title: Pest Control
description: Integrated pest management solutions using safe, approved chemicals and techniques to eliminate and prevent pest infestations.
shortDescription: Integrated pest management with safe, approved methods.

title: Pantry Management
description: Professional pantry and cafeteria management: corporate dining, event catering, and menu planning with hygienic food handling, timely service, and a comfortable break experience.
shortDescription: Hygienic pantry and cafeteria operations management.

title: Garden Maintenance
description: Expert gardening and landscape management that keeps lawns, planters and outdoor areas healthy, tidy and presentable through every season.
shortDescription: Gardening and landscape upkeep for green spaces.

title: Help Desk
description: Trained front office personnel delivering a professional first impression: reception management, visitor handling, and help desk support.
shortDescription: Professional reception and help desk management.

title: Facade Cleaning
description: Interior and exterior glass surfaces cleaned with streak-free professional equipment, plus specialized facade, high-roof, and high-rise cleaning that keeps building exteriors pristine.
shortDescription: External building cleaning with specialized equipment.

title: Waste Management
description: Eco-friendly waste collection, segregation, and recycling programs that reduce your environmental footprint, built on source segregation, organic composting, and tech-driven SOPs.
shortDescription: Eco-friendly waste collection, segregation, and recycling programs.

title: Factory & Production Manpower
description: Trained operators, helpers and support staff deployed to factory and production environments, with safety briefings, attendance tracking and statutory compliance handled for you.
shortDescription: Skilled and unskilled manpower for factory floors and production lines.

title: Warehousing & Supply Chain Manpower
description: Pickers, packers, loaders and stores staff for warehouses and distribution centres, deployed at the volumes your operation needs and scaled up for peak periods.
shortDescription: Skilled and unskilled manpower for warehouses and supply chain operations.

title: Corporate Office Manpower
description: Skilled manpower for corporate offices, including office assistants, accounts and store executives, and administrative support that keeps day-to-day operations running smoothly.
shortDescription: Office assistants, accounts and store executives for corporate workplaces.

title: Contract Staffing
description: Right people, right place, right time. We deploy professionally trained manpower with defined SOPs, KPIs and safety practices, and manage payroll administration, statutory deductions and regulatory compliance so you can focus on your core business.
shortDescription: Trained manpower on contract, with payroll and compliance handled end to end.

title: Marble Polishing & Floor Restoration
description: Diamond polishing, grinding and restoration for marble, granite and other hard floors, restoring shine and protecting the surface against daily wear.
shortDescription: Marble polishing and floor restoration that brings surfaces back to life.

title: Deep Cleaning
description: Scheduled or one-off deep cleaning for commercial and residential properties, using professional scrubbers and approved chemicals to reach what daily housekeeping cannot.
shortDescription: Intensive deep cleaning for commercial and residential spaces.

title: Sofa, Carpet & Chair Shampooing
description: Hot water extraction and shampoo treatment that lifts dust, stains and odour out of upholstery, carpets and office chairs without damaging the fabric.
shortDescription: Shampoo and extraction cleaning for sofas, carpets and chairs.

title: High Roof & Ceiling Cleaning
description: Height-trained teams clean high roofs, ceilings, ducting and overhead fixtures using access platforms and full safety harnessing, with minimal disruption to your operations.
shortDescription: Safe cleaning of high roofs, ceilings and overhead fixtures.

title: Indoor Plant Rentals
description: Indoor plants on rental for lobbies, workstations and meeting rooms, with scheduled watering, pruning and replacement so the greenery always looks its best.
shortDescription: Indoor plants supplied, placed and maintained on rental.

title: Chair Servicing & Refurbishing
description: Office chair servicing that replaces worn gas lifts, castors and mechanisms and re-covers tired upholstery, extending the life of your existing furniture.
shortDescription: Servicing, repair and refurbishing of office chairs.

title: Electrical Works
description: Licensed electricians for wiring, fittings, panel work and fault rectification, covering both planned preventive maintenance and emergency call-outs.
shortDescription: Electrical installation, repair and preventive maintenance.

title: Plumbing & Sanitaryware Works
description: Plumbing and sanitaryware works covering installation, leak detection and repair, drainage clearing and fixture replacement across washrooms, pantries and utility areas.
shortDescription: Plumbing, sanitaryware installation and leak repairs.

title: Carpentry Works
description: Carpenters for partitions, storage, door and furniture repair and custom joinery, working to your drawings or ours.
shortDescription: Carpentry, joinery and furniture repair.

title: Civil Works
description: Civil works covering masonry, plastering, tiling, waterproofing and structural repair, delivered by supervised teams with proper material control.
shortDescription: Masonry, tiling, waterproofing and structural repairs.

title: Painting Works
description: Surface preparation, priming and painting for interiors and exteriors, scheduled around your operations and finished with proper site protection and clean-up.
shortDescription: Interior and exterior painting with minimal disruption.

title: Workstation Installation & Repair
description: Installation, moves and repair of modular workstations and office furniture, including reconfiguring layouts as teams grow or move floors.
shortDescription: Workstation installation, reconfiguration and repair.

title: HVAC Maintenance
description: Scheduled servicing and repair for split, cassette and ducted air-conditioning, covering filter cleaning, gas charging and breakdown response under an AMC or on call.
shortDescription: Air-conditioning servicing, repair and preventive maintenance.

title: Renovation & Interiors
description: Interior fit-outs and renovation handled as a single package, from layout and material selection through civil, electrical and finishing works to handover.
shortDescription: Interior fit-outs and renovation, managed end to end.

title: Metal & Aluminium Fabrication
description: Fabrication and installation of grills, railings, partitions, doors and custom structures in mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium.
shortDescription: Fabrication and installation in metal and aluminium.

title: Signage & Display Boards
description: Design, fabrication and installation of signage, wayfinding and display boards, from reception branding to statutory and safety signage across the site.
shortDescription: Design and installation of signage and display boards.

title: Chiller Maintenance & Repair
description: Planned servicing and repair for chiller plants, including performance checks, water treatment coordination and breakdown support to keep cooling reliable.
shortDescription: Chiller servicing, repair and performance checks.
